about_the_game:
Hope is Fading is set in the distant future, where you play a robotic character lost and separated from its combat unit. Facing a losing battle, you are the last hope against the relentless corrupted machines that are pulling the world apart.

Complete a Failed Mission in a Ruined World
Step into the aftermath of a catastrophic event, where everything now lies in rust and ruin. It’s your job to pick up the pieces of a mission left incomplete.

Confront the Horde

Fight off swarms of robotic combat units designed for war.
Survive encounters with zombie like wanderers who stagger through the wreckage.

Scavenge and Craft

Track down raw materials and blueprints scattered throughout the environment or looted from defeated enemies.
Forge stronger armor that boosts your resilience against overwhelming odds

Energy Management

Keep a close eye on your power core, ensuring your energy levels remain high enough for crucial abilities.

Weapon Upgrades

Enhance damage output, reload speed, or customize crosshairs.

content_descriptors.notes: Gameplay consists of frequent combat scenarios with characters using their weapons to shoot and slash robotic enemies.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: Intel I7 7th Gen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 2070 - 1080p
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum settings are being heavily tested and optimized, will be updated closer to launch
